name: Baby Jogger City Select (Single Mode)
notes: Modular single-to-double convertible (single mode). Per-seat max 45 lb. On Clek's list via City Select adapter 2013551 (Maxi-Cosi/Cybex) — Clek flags it DISCONTINUED, with a handle-position caveat (car seat not usable in the lowest handle position). Unfolded 43.5 x 25.8 x 41.5 in derived from Strollberry (105.5 x 65.5 x 110.5-119 cm, h x w x l); lengthIn set to base 43.5 in (110.5 cm) but extends to ~46.9 in (119 cm) with leg rest/recline. MSRP ~$449.99 reference; Baby Jogger US line wound down.
